sources.title: Historic American Buildings Survey CA-1958
sources.facts: White wooden siding/shingles, four ocean-side storeys and five on other wings; open courtyard, verandas, turrets and varied roofs. Historical architectural description, not a present-day survey.

sources.title: Official Hotel del Coronado resort map
sources.facts: Browser-inspected layout distinguishes the historic Victorian courtyard building and its main ocean-front turret from separate resort neighborhoods and facilities.

sources.title: Hotel restoration completion, June 18, 2025
sources.facts: Later restoration changes are acknowledged; this source model follows dated local exterior references rather than claiming exact 2025 finishes.

notes: Primary front original plus three supplementary local originals inspected. No reference photograph redistributed. Hidden facade spacing, roof joins and heights are conservative interpretations.
